idea-plugin.name: OpenAPI Security Contract Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the lines in an OpenAPI file that publish an endpoint with no authentication, an API key in the query string, or an OAuth grant RFC 9700 forbids.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → OpenAPI Security Contract Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/openapi-security-contract-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/openapi-security-contract-lint

action.text: OpenAPI Security Contract Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run OpenAPI Security Contract Lint on the file in the editor
